description: DiligenceOps: submit two versions of a terms or contract text (before and after, plain or HTML, up to 256 KB each) and get a signed report of the clauses added, removed or materially changed, grouped by topic (fees, refund, cancellation, ownership, liability, term), each quoted briefly with its offset. A change is material when a figure, an obligation word, a negation or a topic changes. Wording-only edits are counted separately. POST /api/contract-diff-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

after.description: The later version, up to 256 KB.

after_label.description: Optional name for the later version.

before.description: The earlier version of the terms or contract, up to 256 KB.

before_label.description: Optional name for the earlier version, for example "Terms of 2026-06-01".

format.description: html extracts the readable text first. Defaults to text.

name: wever_contract-diff-check
title: Contract diff check
